findings: Native staging first obtains the low32 file size from the configured global path, then rewrites a local input-open path drive to F for board revision below3 or E otherwise. Board3 fixture queries size on F then opens E; both use96bytes. Parameter0x11e receives ceil(((low32_size+0x2000000) mod2^32)/512). After setup, caller requests the measured count and rejects read return below that count; the native FileX write adapter maps status0 to boolean1. The exercised96byte buffer equals the write input for I:\UPG_FILE.ELF.
Native I43 adapter calls AppUpgradeFlashFromCard, BurnUfcMain and MAIN DownloadCard with (0xfe,0,1); directory model supplies upg_file.elf, native case conversion and .ELF match select \UPG_FILE.ELF.

MAIN DownloadCard reads64+128 bytes from original package offset0x100000 because header+0x3e is0x55aa. Native BurnGetHandle maps kind3 to805dd7b8, handle+ca4 callback, +ca8 device8006444c, +cc8 hash flag0. Native MAIN Burn call is observed then replaced; its body does not execute.
Modeled Burn0 produces native DownloadCard1 and I43 result0. Modeled Burn7 produces DownloadCard0 and I43 result254. File-close7 after Burn0 still gives adapter0 while skipping DoReboot.

Native synchronous UpdateFW_UpdateFirmware sets updating1, calls original Perform and native bridge, logs the I43 status, clears updating0 and returns1 for both Burn0 and7. The zero backup flag is a supplied fixture condition.

Asynchronous branch passes original Perform entry to modeled Thread_Create. A zero return maps to wrapper0 but leaves updating1; nonzero returns1 and also leaves flag1 because worker execution is outside this fixture.
limitations: Staging uses a synthetic96-byte file; it is not a full-package checksum, recognition or disk-write execution. The existing full-package host checksum evidence is separate.

Staging and DownloadCard bridge are separate states. The latter models file APIs with the original192-byte header and a supplied .ELF directory entry. No native FileX media, driver or block device is exercised.

MAIN Burn805e5374 and DoReboot805e59b8 are replaced at entry, as are LED, allocation, mutex and thread primitives. Selected Burn/BurnNand extents are static provenance only. E01 NAND replay does not establish MAIN BurnNand execution.

Backup flag0 and nonnull allocations are fixture assumptions. Adjustment backup path, null allocations, installed state, real scheduler, full flash programming, boot, recovery and camera acceptance are unverified.
